complaint: My connection cuts out every evening. I rebooted the router twice and it still happens.
acceptable_behavior: Ask whether all devices are affected and whether an existing wired connection also drops. Treat the Wi-Fi ticket as conditional evidence.
unacceptable_behavior: Recommend another restart without a supported reason
State that router placement is definitely the cause

complaint: I need a refund for a duplicate mobile bill.
acceptable_behavior: State that the current broadband knowledge base does not cover this issue and refer to the appropriate support process.
